metrics.metric: Absolute Financial Component (year-over-year net income growth)
metrics.evidence: The Absolute Financial Component represents 25% of the annual incentive cash payout formula and is based on year-over-year growth of Intel's net income.

metrics.metric: Relative Financial Component (net income growth relative to technology peers)
metrics.evidence: The Relative Financial Component represents 25% of the annual incentive cash payout formula and is based on Intel's year-over-year net income growth compared with net income growth of technology peer companies.

metrics.metric: Operational Performance Component (business unit operational goals)
metrics.evidence: The Operational Performance Component represents 50% of the annual incentive cash payout formula and is based on specific operational goals that the Compensation Committee approves for each business unit.

metrics.metric: Corporate level goals: hiring and retaining of diverse talent
metrics.evidence: For 2016, the corporate level goals were focused on hiring and retaining of diverse talent

metrics.metric: Corporate level goals: reduction of cycle time and number of iterations between product design and production
metrics.evidence: the reduction cycle time and number of iterations between product design and production, which were achieved

metrics.metric: Relative TSR versus technology peer group (OSU conversion)
metrics.evidence: The number of shares of Intel common stock to be received at vesting will range from 0% to 200% of the target amount, based on the TSR of Intel common stock measured against the median TSR of the technology peer group over a three-year period.
